note: Both sets bind values to the correct components and properties with supporting quotes, and both contain some redundancy (e.g., brake torque and rotor speed listed twice from prose and table). Set A additionally captures the DOWEC turbine power loss of 0.35 MW with its rated-power and 6.25 MW aerodynamic power conditions, an important fact Set B omits. Set A also binds the generator efficiency and gearbox frictional-loss assumption to the NREL 5-MW baseline turbine more explicitly, while Set B's 'gearbox | frictional losses' entity is slightly less specific. Neither set contains misread or invented values.
